name: orbit
description: Personal team workflow: seven role agents, a /decide PM command, an operator agent, skill and SessionStart handoff hook that keep a team of worker subagents (or peer sessions) in constant progress across compactions, no manual clear or compact, and OKF docs automation. A drift guard (numbered rule ids, versioned skills, triage, session-ledger audit) keeps skills and sessions from drifting; long skills are a short rule core plus refs. Project-specific facts live in a project profile (.agents/project.md).
